appointment_reminder.label: Appointment reminder
appointment_reminder.subject: Appointment reminder
appointment_reminder.text: Hi {name}, this is a reminder from {business} about your appointment on {date}. Reply to this message if you need to change it.

follow_up.label: Follow-up after a visit
follow_up.subject: Thanks for your visit
follow_up.text: Hi {name}, thanks for visiting {business} on {date}. If anything wasn't right, just reply and let us know.

review_request.label: Review request
review_request.subject: How did we do?
review_request.text: Hi {name}, thanks for choosing {business}. If you have a minute, we would appreciate a review: {review_link}

invoice_nudge.label: Invoice reminder
invoice_nudge.subject: Invoice reminder
invoice_nudge.text: Hi {name}, a friendly reminder that invoice {invoice} for {amount} was due on {date}. Please reply if you have any questions.
